text:
ravi: Woke up to my YAML adding a note: `# sorry for the whitespace` and now I feel personally attacked. :crying_cat_face:
zoe: same. mine appended `version: 0.0.0-identity-crisis` and a haiku. Can't unsee.
mae: tiny poll: which is the worst surprise in prod? react :one: fake semver, :two: hidden tabs, :three: missing key
zoe: :one: semver fibs get dashboards confused.
ravi: :two: hidden tabs make local dev collapse in silence.
build-bot: CI report: config.yml:14: mixed indentation detected. severity: passive-aggressive. Suggested action: supply coffee. :coffee:
lint-buddy: FYI per style guide, avoid tags like `v1.2.3-ish`. Autocorrect will not apologize.
mae: best commit title I saw today: "chore: console-therapy for YAML (offered cookies)"
zoe: code meme of the hour:
```diff
- version: 1.0.0
+ version: 1.0.0-please-be-kind
```
ravi: Also saw a branch named `fix/semver-wasp-nest`. 100% would not overlap with prod. :wasp:
mae: compiler gossip: the optimizer invited the parser to a trust fall and the parser declined. :nerd_face:
build-bot: Reminder: run `make lint-yaml` and don't push `version: latest` to prod. Automatic rollback engaged for ambiguous tags.
zoe: sticker idea for the kitchen: "YAML: respect the whitespace or buy the coffee."
ravi: closing TL;DR: be kind to configs, teach semver honesty, and if YAML cries, listen. Emoji summary: :coffee: :bug: :sparkles:
